sentences.text: 2. Ms. Sonia A. Menon, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits, that the petitioners have been owners in possession of the subject land ever since they acquired it vide 2 sale deeds dated 27.08.1987.
A copy of one of the sale deeds has been appended to the petition.
Ms. Menon undertakes to bring on record a copy of the second sale deed as well, before the next date.

3. Counsel submits, that as evident by the documents appended to the petition, vide letter dated 29.03.1979 the Delhi Development Authority ('DDA') had confirmed that they have no objection to construction of group housing on the subject land, also implicit in which was the confirmation that the land was not under acquisition.
4. Pursuant thereto, learned counsel points-out, the predecessors-in- interest of the petitioners deposited certain charges towards the development of the subject land.

5.

Ms. Menon points-out, that more recently, in view of the confusion prevailing in relation to the subject land, the petitioners sent to the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs of the Government of India a notice dated 17.04.2023 under section 55 of the Delhi Development Authority Act 1957,
requesting that the subject land be regularised and praying for the same relief as has been prayed-for in the present petition.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Counsel submits that no response has been received to the said notice dated 17.04.2023.
6. Issue notice.

7. Counsel, as above, appear on behalf of the respondents on advance copy; accept notice; and seek time to file counter-affidavit.
8. Let counter-affidavits be filed within 06 weeks; rejoinders thereto, if any, be filed within 04 weeks thereafter; with copies to the opposing counsel.
9. Re-notify on 23rd April 2024.
ANUP JAIRAM BHAMBHANI, J DECEMBER 12, 2023/ak
